penalty_proof.argument: Any infeasible state violates cardinality by at least one, so its energy is at least -reward_upper_bound+penalty > 0; every feasible state's energy is -score <= 0. Therefore every global minimizer is feasible.

qubo.convention: E(x)=offset+sum_i linear[i] x_i+sum_{i<j} quadratic[i,j] x_i x_j

source_problem.problem: fixed-cardinality project selection with pairwise complementarity
source_problem.variable_definition: x_i=1 when project i is selected, otherwise 0
